question: A neighbourhood association must decide how to use a small empty lot for the next two years.
context: The budget is the same for both options. Volunteers are available on weekends.
option_a: Turn the lot into shared vegetable beds that residents tend together.
option_b: Turn the lot into a quiet seating area with trees and benches.
priority_A: Growing food together with neighbours matters more to us than having a calm place to sit.
priority_B: Having a calm place to sit matters more to us than growing food together with neighbours.
